{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "brunoerg",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "reported mutation testing gaps, raised DoS concern regarding quadratic minisketch decoding times, noted potential connection overage during v2-v1 downgrade, and noted BIP 330 recon_result parsing"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "r:4593554791",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "harm": "test coverage gaps in extension handling, boundary conditions, INV relay side effects, and state cleanup leave edge case bugs undetected",
      "quote": "The survivors are mostly about what happens around the edges of the protocol, not the central flow.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5285786144",
        "c:5317708143"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "c:5317708143",
      "settled_by_quote": "Finished covering the most relevant mutants. Left out the ones regarding extensions, as I'm still debating whether those will be part of the PR."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3897009587",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "harm": "reconciliation peers could exceed m_max_outbound_full_recon during v2-to-v1 fallback due to a race condition lacking eviction handling",
      "quote": "Could reconcilitation peers exceed `m_max_outbound_full_recon` during v2-to-v1 fallback? Thinking about a possible race.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3903186205",
        "c:5492745419",
        "c:5545629138"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "c:5545629138",
      "settled_by_quote": "With this, I should have also covered your concern about v2->v1 downgrades, as outbound reconciliations now have eviction logic."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3897073818",
      "kind": "safety",
      "harm": "malicious peers can trigger expensive minisketch decoding taking 30+ seconds, blocking message processing and causing a DoS",
      "quote": "I got 31.2 seconds on my machine (Ryzen 9 7900). Wondering if a malicious peer could use it to cause a DoS since it would block all msgs processings?",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "open",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3902587961"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "",
      "settled_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3897104353",
      "kind": "interface",
      "harm": "non-conformance with BIP 330 by accepting any non-zero byte as true instead of strictly 0 or 1",
      "quote": "nit: I think that, according to the BIP330, we must accept 0 or 1 here. This way it would treat any nonzero byte as true.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3902663460",
        "c:5492745419"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "c:5492745419",
      "settled_by_quote": "I changed the way we parse `recon_result` to mimic the check we already have in place for BIP152. Also added a test for it."
    }
  ],
  "support": [],
  "notes": "Initial assessment populated. Recorded concerns from brunoerg regarding mutation test gaps, v2-v1 race condition, minisketch decoding DoS, and BIP 330 parsing. The DoS concern remains open pending decisions on capping sketch size and dropping extensions."
}

participants.note: reported mutation testing gaps, raised DoS concern regarding quadratic minisketch decoding times, noted potential connection overage during v2-v1 downgrade, and noted BIP 330 recon_result parsing

claims.harm: test coverage gaps in extension handling, boundary conditions, INV relay side effects, and state cleanup leave edge case bugs undetected
claims.quote: The survivors are mostly about what happens around the edges of the protocol, not the central flow.
claims.settled_by_quote: Finished covering the most relevant mutants. Left out the ones regarding extensions, as I'm still debating whether those will be part of the PR.

claims.harm: reconciliation peers could exceed m_max_outbound_full_recon during v2-to-v1 fallback due to a race condition lacking eviction handling
claims.quote: Could reconcilitation peers exceed `m_max_outbound_full_recon` during v2-to-v1 fallback? Thinking about a possible race.
claims.settled_by_quote: With this, I should have also covered your concern about v2->v1 downgrades, as outbound reconciliations now have eviction logic.

claims.harm: malicious peers can trigger expensive minisketch decoding taking 30+ seconds, blocking message processing and causing a DoS
claims.quote: I got 31.2 seconds on my machine (Ryzen 9 7900). Wondering if a malicious peer could use it to cause a DoS since it would block all msgs processings?

claims.harm: non-conformance with BIP 330 by accepting any non-zero byte as true instead of strictly 0 or 1

claims.settled_by_quote: I changed the way we parse `recon_result` to mimic the check we already have in place for BIP152. Also added a test for it.
